title: Home Oxygen Therapy Field Evidence Standard: Oxygen in Use at Home Before a Stay
content:
# Oxygen in Use at Home Before a Stay — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Standard.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy suspension, the evidence day dates the suspension only when the most recent cylinder refill on the oxygen record, or the setup date when no cylinder refill is on record, falls on or before the evidence day and no more than the window below before it. The window is the class's portable cylinder delivery cycle for a class with portable cylinder refills, the class's liquid reservoir refill cycle for a class with liquid refills, and 0 days for any other class. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the suspension is dated on the day the stay is reported.

## Window by system class

| System class | Kind of refills | Window (calendar days before the evidence day) |
|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | none | 0 |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | portable cylinders, every 14 days | 14 |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | none | 0 |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | none | 0 |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | liquid, every 7 days | 7 |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | portable cylinders, every 14 days | 14 |

## The date measured

| Cylinder refill on the oxygen record | Date measured against the evidence day |
|---|---|
| at least one | the most recent cylinder refill |
| none | the setup date |

## Both sides (hypothetical, evidence day 20 October)

| Class window | Date measured | Gap | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 6 October | 14 days | met |
| 14 | 5 October | 15 days | fails |
| 14 | 21 October | after the evidence day | fails |
| 7 | 13 October | 7 days | met |
| 7 | 12 October | 8 days | fails |
| 0 | 20 October | 0 days | met |
| 0 | 19 October | 1 day | fails |
